-- StormController (Server)
-- Controla iluminação dramática, atmosfera noturna e clarões ocasionais limitados (relâmpagos)

local Lighting = game:GetService("Lighting")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local stormFolder = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("CinematicStorm")

-- Configurar ambiente noturno cinematográfico
Lighting.ClockTime = 0 -- Meia-noite
Lighting.Brightness = 0.5
Lighting.OutdoorAmbient = Color3.fromRGB(30, 35, 50)
Lighting.Ambient = Color3.fromRGB(15, 20, 30)
Lighting.FogEnd = 300
Lighting.FogColor = Color3.fromRGB(20, 25, 35)

-- Criar Atmosphere se não existir
local atmosphere = Lighting:FindFirstChildOfClass("Atmosphere")
if not atmosphere then
	atmosphere = Instance.new("Atmosphere")
	atmosphere.Parent = Lighting
end
atmosphere.Density = 0.4
atmosphere.Offset = 0.25
atmosphere.Color = Color3.fromRGB(30, 35, 45)
atmosphere.Decay = Color3.fromRGB(15, 20, 25)
atmosphere.Glare = 0.1
atmosphere.Haze = 1.5

-- RemoteEvent para sincronizar clarões com os clientes
local lightningEvent = stormFolder:FindFirstChild("LightningEvent")
if not lightningEvent then
	lightningEvent = Instance.new("RemoteEvent")
	lightningEvent.Name = "LightningEvent"
	lightningEvent.Parent = stormFolder
end

-- Loop de clarões ocasionais limitados
task.spawn(function()
	while true do
		local waitTime = math.random(12, 25) -- Intervalo ocasional limitado
		task.wait(waitTime)
		
		-- Disparar clarão no servidor e notificar clientes
		lightningEvent:FireAllClients()
		
		Lighting.Brightness = 2.5
		Lighting.OutdoorAmbient = Color3.fromRGB(200, 200, 220)
		task.wait(0.08)
		Lighting.Brightness = 0.2
		Lighting.OutdoorAmbient = Color3.fromRGB(60, 60, 80)
		task.wait(0.05)
		Lighting.Brightness = 2.0
		Lighting.OutdoorAmbient = Color3.fromRGB(180, 180, 200)
		task.wait(0.12)
		
		-- Retornar ao padrão noturno sombrio
		Lighting.Brightness = 0.5
		Lighting.OutdoorAmbient = Color3.fromRGB(30, 35, 50)
	end
end)

-- StormClientEffect (Client)
-- Cria partículas de chuva inclinada cinematográfica e efeito visual de clarão nos clientes

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Lighting = game:GetService("Lighting")

local localPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer
local character = localPlayer.Character or localPlayer.CharacterAdded:Wait()
local humanoidRootPart = character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")

local stormFolder = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("CinematicStorm")
local lightningEvent = stormFolder:WaitForChild("LightningEvent")

-- Container para efeitos de chuva presos ao jogador (otimizado para mobile)
local rainAttachment = Instance.new("Attachment")
rainAttachment.Name = "RainAttachment"
rainAttachment.Parent = humanoidRootPart

local rainEmitter = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
rainEmitter.Name = "CinematicRain"
rainEmitter.Texture = "rbxassetid://606348149" -- Textura padrão segura do Roblox para partículas
rainEmitter.Rate = 250 -- Orçamento mobile respeitado
rainEmitter.Speed = NumberRange.new(45, 60)
rainEmitter.VelocitySpread = 15
rainEmitter.Acceleration = Vector3.new(-15, -60, -10) -- Chuva inclinada realista
lifetime = NumberRange.new(1.0, 1.5)
rainEmitter.Lifetime = lifetime
rainEmitter.Size = NumberSequence.new({
	NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0.1),
	NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0.05)
})
rainEmitter.Transparency = NumberSequence.new({
	NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0.2),
	NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.8, 0.3),
	NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1)
})
rainEmitter.Color = ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(180, 200, 220))
rainEmitter.Parent = rainAttachment

-- Efeito visual de clarão no cliente quando o evento for disparado
lightningEvent.OnClientEvent:Connect(function()
	-- Piscar levemente a exposição ou efeito de flash na tela se desejado
	local originalBrightness = Lighting.Brightness
	Lighting.Brightness = 3.0
	task.wait(0.1)
	Lighting.Brightness = originalBrightness
end)
